newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint firms vs dlr, BCE yen futures main movers.
newsitem.headline: Forint firms vs dlr, BCE yen futures main movers.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed Friday's interbank forex market firmer from opening levels against the dollar, with dealers saying this week's larger than usual foreign currency purchases were probably finished.
"The (foreign currency) buying risk next week will be higher," said Zsolt Tiliman of Magyar Kulkeresekedelmi Bank.
The forint closed at 151.23/28 to the U.S. unit compared with its opening of 151.35/40, some 10 pips below the central bank resistance level.
Earlier, the forint had traded as much as 30 pips below the central bank's resistance level.
A quiet Friday on the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) resulted in a 1.12 billion forints turnover, with yen, Ecu and dollar contracts accounting for most of the day's trade.
Yen futures were the main movers, dropping in all 1997 maturities. The dollar ended mixed, the Ecu dropped in two maturities and other currency futures ended mostly steady.
